clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Mudsnout Composite is prepared for the Royal Apothecary Society's research into a new plague. Apothecary Lydon makes it from Mudsnout Blossoms gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills and sends it to the Undercity.

Apothecary Lydon makes Mudsnout Composite from Mudsnout Blossoms gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The paste is noxious on its own, but Master Apothecary Faranell must bind it with a colloid of decay to bring out its deadlier qualities. Together, the ingredients form a key chemical component in the Dark Lady's Elixir of Agony.
